claim: If R(3,10)=40, every K4-free graph G on 40 vertices satisfies beta(G)>=10.
order40_erdos151_consequence: The K4-free order-40 lane is cleared: the displayed claim applies if R(3,10)=40; if R(3,10)=41, beta>=9 follows from the verified order-39 theorem by monotonicity.

primary_dependencies.citation: A. Bikov, Small minimal (3,3)-Ramsey graphs, Theorem 8.2 and Figure 13
O. V. Borodin and A. V. Kostochka, On an Upper Bound of a Graph's Chromatic Number, Depending on the Graph's Degree and Density, Corollary 2

scope: Conditional strong theorem for the K4-free order-40 lane only. Clique numbers four and five, and the full Erdős problem, remain outside this result.
